# Hold-out R2 by modelling approach

This script gives the following figure: Figure 5, Hold-Out \(R^2\) by Modelling Approach and Predictor Representation (Results section).

## Data

The ten values below are the hold-out \(R^2\) estimates reported in Table 1. They are given in the order linear mixed-effects model, GAMM, random forest, gradient boosted trees, and neural network.

```{r}
# load required libraries
library(tidyverse)

# trait_score holds the aligned Big Five scores, and item_level holds the BFI-S items.
holdout_r2 <- tibble(
  model = factor(
    c("LMM", "GAMM", "RF", "XGB", "NN"),
    levels = c("LMM", "GAMM", "RF", "XGB", "NN")
  ),
  trait_score = c(0.161, 0.164, 0.165, 0.169, 0.167),
  item_level = c(0.175, 0.179, 0.177, 0.187, 0.182)
)

# Each value becomes one row, so each point in the figure has its own row.
holdout_r2_long <- holdout_r2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(trait_score, item_level),
    names_to = "representation",
    values_to = "r2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    representation = factor(
      representation,
      levels = c("trait_score", "item_level"),
      labels = c("Aligned Big Five scores", "BFI-S items")
    )
  )
```

## Drawing the figure

```{r}
# The black line connects the two hold-out R2 values of each modelling approach.
figure_holdout_r2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = holdout_r2,
    aes(
      x = model,
      xend = model,
      y = trait_score,
      yend = item_level
    ),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  # The points are the hold-out R2 values, coloured by predictor representation.
  geom_point(
    data = holdout_r2_long,
    aes(
      x = model,
      y = r2,
      colour = representation
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  # The aligned-score value is printed below its point.
  geom_text(
    data = holdout_r2_long %>%
      filter(representation == "Aligned Big Five scores"),
    aes(
      x = model,
      y = r2,
      label = sprintf("%.3f", r2)
    ),
    colour = "black",
    nudge_y = -0.0015,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  # The item value is printed above its point.
  geom_text(
    data = holdout_r2_long %>%
      filter(representation == "BFI-S items"),
    aes(
      x = model,
      y = r2,
      label = sprintf("%.3f", r2)
    ),
    colour = "black",
    nudge_y = 0.0015,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  # The aligned-score points are blue and the item points are orange.
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Aligned Big Five scores" = "#1F77B4",
      "BFI-S items" = "#FF7F0E"
    )
  ) +
  # The y-axis runs from 0.15 to 0.20.
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0.15, 0.20),
    breaks = seq(0.15, 0.20, by = 0.01),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Modelling approach",
    y = "Hold-out R\u00B2",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "plain"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

# The figure is shown in the R output.
figure_holdout_r2
```

## Saving the figure

```{r}
# The figure is saved as the PDF for Figure 5, Hold-Out R2 by Modelling Approach and Predictor Representation (Results section).
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(
  "figures/figure_holdout_r2.pdf",
  plot = figure_holdout_r2,
  width = 19.05,
  height = 11.94,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
